vol_boundary_points — 3D boundary op

• Data kinds: voxel → points

• Call: import volops; volops.vol_boundary_points(vol_binary, spacing=None, connectivity=6, origin=(0, 0, 0)) (or ops3d.get("vol_boundary_points"))

Usage

Boundary shell as an `(N, 3) point cloud in (z, y, x)` order.
